Areas

Eleven regions across three genres (Old West, fantasy and sci-fi), from the safe frontier town to the Abyss. Each shows its level range, terrain, monsters, resources and how to get there.

Old WestFantasySci-fiModern Each area is styled for its genre.

Ashfall Junction

Safe hub · Old West 26 rooms one floor

An Old West boom town where the roads between worlds meet: the Silver Spur Saloon, shops, temple, Chrome Clinic, guild and the Hall of Rebirth. Almost every room here is safe from combat.

Getting thereYou start here.
Terrainconcrete (10), metal (6), stone (6), dirt (3), grass (1)
Resourcesore ×4
Monsters🐀 giant rat (1)
Quest giversFixer Torv, Doc Elara, Brann the Smith, Mara the Innkeeper, Captain Hale, Old Pell, Inker Dax, Armorer Gunnar Ironbound, Salvage Boss Pike, Engineer Dex, Widow Mae, Dusty Pete

Modern District

The Primeval Rift

Levels 21 to 28 · Prehistoric 22 rooms one floor

Step into the mysterious portal at the Mirage Gate in the Sunscorch Dunes (enter portal) and you arrive in a prehistoric valley of tree ferns, tar pits and dinosaurs: raptors, pterosaurs, triceratops, stegosaurs, allosaurs, a spinosaur and Rex the Tyrant. Dr. Mara Quill runs the camp at the landing.

Exterminus

Levels 60 to 78 · Sci-fi 92 rooms one floor

A planet of 91 rooms ruled by the Exterminators: metallic, sentient robots with laser rifles who drop unobtainium. reached on foot through the future realm (`future` at Ashfall Square). Scavenger Quinn gives the quests; the boss is Exterminator Prime, Unit 001.

Blimble Hollow

Levels 1 to 10 · Fantasy · newbie area 31 rooms one floor

A cheerful village of little green folk, the Blimbles, in mushroom houses, and the perfect first adventure: the fantasy gate at Ashfall Square (`fantasy`). 30 rooms in a 6 x 5 grid: a safe village with a market, bakery, healer and inn, the Berry Meadow, the Gloomwood and Witherwood Hill, ending at the tower of Grimbold the Gloom, an evil wizard, and his evil cat familiar Shadowpaw. Elder Bumbleberry gives a six-quest chain.

Castle in the Clouds

Level 100 · Fantasy 60 rooms one floor

Sunny Acres Farm

Any level · Farm 15 rooms one floor

A peaceful working farm just out of Ashfall: type `farm` in Ashfall Square. Till, plant and harvest vegetables in the fields, milk the cows in the Red Barn, shear the sheep in the pastures, and sell it all to the old farmer at the Farmer's Market. 15 rooms in a grid. Four tradeskills (tilling, planting, milking, shearing) with a master farmer's reward at level 20: denim overalls and a golden hoe. The farmer, cows and sheep are level 50: kill them and you are banned from the farm for an hour.

Getting therefarm from the starting square
Terraingrass (9), water (1), dirt (5)
Resourcesfish ×6
Monsters🐑 woolly sheep (50), 🧑‍🌾 old farmer (50), 🐄 dairy cow (50)
Quest giversnone

Castle Frankenstein

A gaunt castle on the ridge east of the witch circle in Nightfall Hollow (go east from the Cauldron Pit). 36 rooms on three levels: a courtyard, graveyard and great hall; the laboratory tower above, where Dr. Victor Frankenstein rages among the lightning rods; and the dungeon below, where Frankenstein's Monster waits. Mars

Levels 30 to 40 · Sci-fi 106 rooms two floors

The planet is at war with Pluto: east of the Twisting Passage is the Martian Fleet Dock (Admiral Glorp, and the warship Crimson Fang that flies to Pluto), and Plutonian raiders prowl the canyons. Reached by the starship Tharsis, docked beside Frostpeak Station (go in, north twice, then launch in the cockpit). A 100-room red planet of little green Martians with ray guns, laid out in a 10 by 10 grid: dust flats and craters near the landing pad, then a canyon of snipers, a Martian city of saucer pilots and officers, and the Overlord's citadel at the far corner. Commander Reyes at the landing pad gives the quests; the Martian Overlord Zorgblat carries the unique Death Ray Gun.
